scene: Inferno XXIII — gilded lead cloaks, hypocrites and Malacoda's false route
story: After the Malebranche quarrel, Dante fears pursuit and warns Virgil. Virgil gathers Dante in his arms and slides down the steep bank into the sixth bolgia, escaping the demons who cannot leave their assigned ditch.
The hypocrites proceed slowly under cloaks that appear golden outside but are lined with heavy lead.
Dante and Virgil speak with Catalano and Loderingo, the two Jovial Friars from Bologna.
The travelers see Caiaphas fixed to the ground and crucified, bearing the weight of those who pass over him; the hypocrites identify his role in condemning Jesus.
They learn that the bridge Malacoda claimed they could use is broken, exposing the demon's directions as false.
Virgil departs with Dante toward the next accessible climb. The correction of the route is observed but completion of the next crossing is reserved.
